rv.q: It is a humane and, in the final scene, touching vision. But it is also one that is slow in coming.
It is, above all, another cracking good show from the master craftsman.

cn.t: Ayckbourn's 91st play earns praise as a generous, timely exploration of friendship and trust in polarized times, with critics applauding its plea for decency and examination of human connection amid modern uncertainty.
